question_content:
Which mean square can be influenced by population differences among group means?
A. MSwithin
B. MSbetween
C. SStotal
D. dfdenominator
The null hypothesis in one-way ANOVA says that all group population means are ___

Why is ANOVA preferred over multiple pairwise t-tests when comparing more than two groups?
A. It reduces the chance of Type I error
B. It guarantees normality
C. It forces equal variances
D. It always increases power

The one-way ANOVA test is always
A. left-tailed
B. two-tailed
C. right-tailed
D. undetermined tail
MS stands for ___

The F distribution is derived from the
A. normal distribution
B. chi-square distribution
C. Student's t-distribution
D. binomial distribution

If H0 is true, the F-ratio should be approximately
A. 0
B. 1
C. k
D. n

What is the F-ratio in one-way ANOVA?
A. MSbetween / MSwithin
B. MSwithin / MSbetween
C. SSbetween / SSwithin
D. MSbetween / SSwithin
If the numerator df is 4 and the denominator df is 10, the distribution is written as ___
In Example 13.1, the computed F statistic equals ___

Which expression equals SSbetween (using group sums s_j and sizes n_j, total n)?
A. Σ[(s_j)^2 / n_j] − (Σ s_j)^2 / n
B. Σ x^2 − (Σ x)^2 / n
C. SStotal − SSbetween
D. SSwithin / dfwithin
SSbetween is the sum of squares that represents the variation ___ the different samples.
The F-ratio is computed as ___ divided by MSwithin.
Within-groups variation is also called variation due to ___ or unexplained variation.

Under the null hypothesis in one-way ANOVA, the F-ratio is expected to be approximately:
A. 0
B. 1
C. n − k
D. k − 1

The one-way ANOVA hypothesis test is always:
A. Left-tailed
B. Two-tailed
C. Right-tailed
D. Depends on the data

Which description matches SStotal?
A. Sum of squares of all values minus the square of the total sum divided by n
B. Sum of squares representing variation among groups
C. Sum of sample variances divided by dfwithin
D. SStotal − SSbetween

The variance within samples is estimated by the ___ of the sample variances.
A. sum
B. average
C. median
D. maximum
One-Way ANOVA is preferred over multiple pairwise t-tests when comparing more than ___ groups.
The alternative hypothesis says that at least ___ of the sample groups come from populations with different normal distributions.

Using μ = df(denom)/(df(denom) − 2), what is the mean of an F distribution (when defined)?
A. df(denom)/(df(denom) − 2)
B. df(num)/(df(num) − 2)
C. df(denom)/(df(denom) + 2)
D. (df(num) + df(denom))/2

From an ANOVA table, F is calculated as:
A. MSbetween divided by MSwithin
B. SSwithin divided by SSbetween
C. MSwithin divided by MSbetween
D. SSbetween divided by dfwithin

Which set correctly pairs one-way ANOVA components with their formulas?
A. dfbetween = k − 1; dfwithin = n − k; F = MSbetween/MSwithin
B. dfbetween = n − k; dfwithin = k − 1; F = SSbetween/SSwithin
C. dfbetween = k; dfwithin = n; F = MSwithin/MSbetween
D. dfbetween = k − 1; dfwithin = n − 1; F = SSwithin/dfwithin

If the null hypothesis is true in one-way ANOVA, which is expected?
A. MSbetween and MSwithin estimate the same variance and F is approximately 1
B. MSbetween greatly exceeds MSwithin and F is near 0
C. MSwithin exceeds MSbetween and F is negative
D. Only MSbetween estimates the common variance and F is left-tailed

For equal group sizes, the variance between samples is computed as:
A. The variance of the sample means multiplied by n
B. The average of the sample variances
C. SSwithin divided by dfwithin
D. The variance of all individual observations divided by n

Variance within samples can be calculated as:
A. The mean of the sample variances (pooled variance) or MSwithin = SSwithin/dfwithin
B. The variance of the sample means multiplied by n
C. SSbetween/dfbetween
D. SStotal − SSbetween divided by k − 1

According to the given formula, SSbetween equals:
A. Σ[(s_j)²/n_j] − (Σ s_j)²/n
B. SSwithin + SStotal
C. Σx²/n − (Σx)²
D. (Σ s_j)²/n − Σ[(s_j)²/n_j]

How is SSwithin obtained?
A. SSwithin = SStotal − SSbetween
B. SSwithin = SSbetween − SStotal
C. SSwithin = SSbetween + SStotal
D. SSwithin = (Σx)²/n − Σx²

Which formulas define MSbetween and MSwithin?
A. MSbetween = SSbetween/dfbetween; MSwithin = SSwithin/dfwithin
B. MSbetween = SSwithin/dfbetween; MSwithin = SSbetween/dfwithin
C. MSbetween = SStotal/dfbetween; MSwithin = SStotal/dfwithin
D. MSbetween = SSbetween × dfbetween; MSwithin = SSwithin × dfwithin

In a one-way ANOVA with total sample size n and k groups, dfwithin is:
A. n − k
B. k − 1
C. n
D. n − 1
The one-way ANOVA hypothesis test is always ____.

In the diet plan example (k = 3, n = 10), what are dfbetween and dfwithin?
A. 2 and 7
B. 3 and 7
C. 2 and 10
D. 9 and 7

Which is the correct formula for the total sum of squares SStotal?
A. ∑x^2 − (∑x)^2 / n
B. ∑x^2 + (∑x)^2 / n
C. (∑x^2)/n − (∑x)^2
D. ∑x^2 − n(∑x)^2

In the notation F ~ F4,10, what do 4 and 10 represent?
A. Numerator df = 4, denominator df = 10
B. Sample sizes of two groups
C. Number of groups and total sample size
D. Means of two samples

When group sizes are equal, which formula for F is used?
A. F = n · s_x̄^2 / s_pooled^2
B. F = s_pooled^2 / (n · s_x̄^2)
C. F = s_pooled^2 / s_x̄^2
D. F = s_x̄^2 / s_pooled^2

Which ratio defines the F statistic in one-way ANOVA?
A. MSbetween/MSwithin
B. MSwithin/MSbetween
C. SSbetween/SSwithin
D. SSwithin/SSbetween

When the null hypothesis is true, the F-ratio should be approximately:
A. 0
B. 1
C. k
D. n

SSwithin is also called:
A. Variation due to error (unexplained)
B. Variation due to treatment (explained)
C. Total variation across all data
D. Between-group variance only

Which statement about MSwithin and MSbetween is true?
A. MSwithin compares values to their own group mean, so differences among group means do not affect it
B. MSbetween is unaffected by differences among group means
C. Both MSwithin and MSbetween are affected only by sampling error
D. Neither MSwithin nor MSbetween estimates variance

Why use one-way ANOVA instead of multiple t-tests for more than two groups?
A. To reduce the chance of a Type 1 error from multiple tests
B. It does not require any assumptions
C. It compares medians instead of means
D. It allows left-tailed tests
